newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ FBT prescribed rate reduced to 11.1 pct - Dunne.
newsitem.headline: NZ FBT prescribed rate reduced to 11.1 pct - Dunne.

text.p: New Zealand Revenue Minister Peter Dunne on Monday announced that the rate of interest used to calculate the fringe benefit value of low interest employment related loans had been decreased to 11.1 percent from 11.5 percent for the quarter commencing October 1, 1996.
Dunne said the new rate was a reflection of the recent fall in market rates.
